prompt: Which practice best exemplifies InnerSource inside a company?
explanation: InnerSource lives on internal transparency: readable repositories, discoverable issues, and contribution norms — so a developer in another team can fix a bug where they found it instead of filing a ticket and waiting.

options.text: Internal repositories stay readable across the org, with CONTRIBUTING guides and issues open to all employees
Each team keeps its repositories invisible to other teams
All code review happens by email attachments
The security team approves every character of every pull request
